P62.s0.text: **Diagnosis.** Differs from all other genera of Adeshini in having a complete, partially crenulate, mid-longitudinal propodeal groove, other genera having at least a partial, and usually complete, mid-longitudinal carina.

P62.s1.text: In addition, unlike other members of the tribe the basal lobe of the claws is distinctly pectinate, and the dorsal valve of the ovipositor has a distinct pre-apical angulation in lateral profile, rather than being smoothly rounded.

P63.s0.text: **Description. Head.** Scapus shorter ventrally than dorsally in lateral aspect.

P63.s2.text: Head transverse. Antennal sockets strongly produced in front of the eyes.

P63.s3.text: Head smooth, setose. Malar suture distinct and complete.

P63.s4.text: Frons depressed behind antennal sockets with mid-longitudinal groove.

P63.s10.text: Median area of metanotum with complete mid-longitudinal carina.

P63.s11.text: Mesopleuron smooth and setose, glabrous medially.

P63.s13.text: Propodeum with crenulated mid-longitudinal groove, with large crenulations posteriorly.

P63.s15.text: Second submarginal cell 2.50× as long as wide.

P63.s18.text: Posterior margin of hind wing weakly emarginate.

P63.s19.text: Base of hind wing without glabrous area next to vein cua.

P63.s20.text: **Legs.** Tarsal claws with acute, pectinate basal lobe.

P63.s22.text: First metasomal tergite with medially united dorsal carina which extend to posterior margin in the form of a mid-longitudinal carina.

P63.s23.text: Second metasomal tergite with smooth, triangular mid-basal area and a short mid-longitudinal carina, pair of posteriorly converging antero-lateral grooves.

P64.s0.text: Fifth metasomal tergite distinctly emarginated postero-laterally.

P64.s1.text: Ovipositor with distinct dorsal angulation and ventral serrations.

P66.s0.text: **Remarks.** The distinct and complete malar suture and crenulated mid-longitudinal groove on the propodeum are putative autapomorphies of Crenuladesha Ranjith & Quicke, gen. nov. In addition to that the presence of postero-lateral semicircular emarginations of the fifth metasomal tergite displays some affinities with the Adesha, Furcadesha and Indadesha.

P66.s1.text: In common with Adesha, Aneuradesha, Furcadesha and Spinadesha are the presence of a mid-longitudinal groove on the frons, smooth vertex, mesosternum and pleural suture and exhibit a lesser character sharing with Africadesha, Aneuradesha and Protadesha on the basis of a single character; smooth mesosternum.

P72.s0.text: **Diagnosis.** The single species of the genus is distinguished from all other members of the tribe by its mid-longitudinally grooved propodeum.

P74.s1.text: Length of body 2.5 mm, of fore wing 2.2 mm, and of ovipositor (part exserted beyond apex of metasoma 0.3 mm.

P74.s3.text: First flagellomere 1.10× and 1.20× as long as the second and third flagellomeres respectively.

P74.s4.text: Third flagellomere 3.30× as long as wide.

P74.s6.text: Height of clypeus: inter-tentorial distance: tentorio-ocular distance= 1.0: 2.2: 1.3.

P75.s0.text: POL: diameter of posterior ocellus: OOL= 1.0: 1.0: 2.5.

P75.s1.text: Malar space 1.50× as long as basal width of mandible.

P75.s3.text: Pronotum protruding anteriorly and not distinctly emarginate in dorsal view, smooth anteriorly with fine striae posteriorly in lateral view.

P75.s4.text: Notauli well developed and not running parallel, moderately converging posteriorly.

P75.s5.text: Scutellar sulcus divided by seven carinae.

P75.s6.text: **Wings.** Length of fore wing veins SR1: 3-SR: r = 8.2: 4.1: 1.0.

P75.s8.text: Vein r as wide as 3-SR. Vein 2-SR slightly thinner than 3-SR.

P75.s9.text: Hind wing vein SC+R1 2.00× as long as 1r-m. **Legs.**

P75.s10.text: Length of fore femur: tibia: basitarsus= 1.7: 2.1: 1.0.

P75.s11.text: Length of hind femur: tibia: basitarsus = 1.7: 2.8: 1.0.

P75.s12.text: **Metasoma.** First metasomal tergite 1.30× wider posteriorly than long.

P75.s13.text: Third metasomal tergite to fifth metasomal tergite sparsely punctate associated with setosity.

P75.s15.text: Ovipositor 0.30× as long as hind tibia.

P75.s16.text: **Coloration.** Reddish brown except mandibles, maxillary and labial palps, anellus, legs, second metasomal tergite medially and third metasomal tergite medio-basally yellow, face yellowish brown, tip of mandibles, pterostigma and venation brown.

P79.s0.text: **Variation.** The yellow coloration on the second metasomal tergite varies within paratypes.

P79.s1.text: Eyes are silvery in one paratype.

P83.s0.text: **Diagnosis.** Differs from all other genera of Adeshini in having fore wing vein 2CU with a clearly-differentiated and sub-transverse basal abscissa (2CUa).

P84.s0.text: **Description. Head.** Scapus shorter ventrally than dorsally in lateral aspect.

P84.s1.text: Head transverse. Head and mesosoma largely finely coriaceous or alutaceous.

P84.s2.text: **Mesosoma.** Mesonotum with very weak narrow mid-longitudinal groove.

P84.s3.text: Notauli narrow, complete, more or less uniting shortly before scutellar sulcus.

P84.s4.text: Precoxal sulcus absent. Median area of metanotum with weak, mid-longitudinal carina.

P84.s6.text: **Wings.** Wings narrow. Fore wing second submarginal cell approximately 1.50× longer than wide.

P84.s10.text: Posterior margin of hind wing weakly emarginate.

P84.s11.text: Base of hind wing without glabrous area next to vein cu-a. **Metasoma.**

P84.s12.text: Metasoma with five fully visible and sculptured tergites; tergites deep with steep sides.

P84.s13.text: Metasomal tergites 3–5 without transverse subposterior grooves.

P84.s14.text: First metasomal tergite not flattened laterally; with weak lateral depression along ventrolateral margin; with small, fenestrate dorsope.

P84.s15.text: Second metasomal tergite without mid-basal or antero-lateral areas, with wide, weak lateral depression that runs along lateral margin as far as the base of third tergite.

P84.s16.text: Second metasomal suture narrow, weakly curved.

P84.s17.text: Fifth metasomal tergite very weakly emarginated posterolaterally.

P84.s18.text: Ovipositor sharp, with a distinct pre-apical dorsal angulation (nodus).

P90.s1.text: **South Africa**, Gauteng, Magaliesburg, Golden valley, private residence, 26.026°S, 27.545°E, 1526 m, coll. Herman Staude (CNCO).

P91.s0.text: **Description.** Length of body 3.2 mm, of fore wing 2.7 mm and of ovipositor (part exserted beyond apex of metasoma 0.3 mm.

P91.s2.text: Flagellomeres 1–3 approximately equal in length, 2.70× longer than wide.

P91.s3.text: Width of head: width of face: height of eye = 3.3: 1.8: 1.0.

P91.s4.text: Face very finely alutaceous with some weak oblique striation ventro-laterally.

P91.s6.text: Malar space long; malar suture absent.

P91.s8.text: Frons not impressed. Shortest distance between posterior ocelli: transverse diameter of posterior ocellus: shortest distance between posterior ocellus and eye = 1.8: 1.0: 2.0.

P91.s9.text: Length of head behind eye 0.22× length of eye in dorsal view.

P91.s11.text: Mesonotum finely coriaceous; notauli finely coriaceous.

P91.s12.text: Mesopleuron weakly alutaceous dorso-laterally but otherwise largely shiny and glabrous.

P91.s13.text: Mesosternum shiny but densely short setose.

P91.s14.text: Propodeum with some irregular sculpture posteriorly.

P91.s17.text: Fore wing vein 2CUa distinct, approximately 0.6× length of 2cu-a. Hind wing vein 1M 7.0× longer than 1r-m. **Legs.**

P91.s18.text: Lengths of fore femur: tibia: tarsus= 1.1: 1.0: 1.68.

P91.s19.text: Lengths of fore femur: tibia: tarsus = 1.0: 1.5: 1.5.

P91.s20.text: **Metasoma.** Metasomal tergites 1–5 alutaceous-coriaceous with some weak superimposed rugose sculpture laterally.

P92.s0.text: Second metasomal tergite 1.5× wider posteriorly than long; 1.2× longer than third metasomal tergite.

P92.s1.text: Ovipositor sheathes approximately as long as hind basitarsus.

P92.s2.text: **Coloration.** Body and legs uniformly dark honey brown except: three small dark marks, one on each lateral lobe and a smaller less distinct one medio-anteriorly on the medial lobe of the mesoscutum; tarsi of all legs which are darker brown.

P92.s3.text: Wings with hyaline membrane and brown venation; pterostigma yellowish medially darker around its borders.
